    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/release-notes-xxxxx.md only to document the removal of the -mempoolexpiry configuration option.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release notes edits that merely follow from a functional change do not make the PR a member of the docs category."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/mempool_options.h and src/kernel/mempool_removal_reason.* to clean up expiry options and reasons.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The edits in src/kernel follow mechanically from removing mempool expiry logic and do not touch the kernel API or boundary."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mempool label and modifies src/txmempool.cpp/.h to eliminate the entry_time index and time-based eviction.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Removes incentive-incompatible eviction that could drop mineable transactions (such as low-feerate parents of fee-bumped packages) and reduces per-entry memory overhead. As noted in issue #33510 and the description, age-based eviction drops transactions that could still be mined, while deleting the entry_time multi-index eliminates an ordered-tree node per entry so more transactions fit within -maxmempool."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes test/functional/mempool_expiry.py and updates fuzz harnesses and functional tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Edits to functional tests and fuzz harnesses follow the removal of mempool expiry behavior rather than changing test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp to warn if the deprecated -mempoolexpiry option is passed.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Handling the retired -mempoolexpiry startup argument is solely in service of mempool configuration, not general node utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes a few lines in src/validation.cpp and validation headers relating to expiry handling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter consensus validity or chainstate logic; incidental edits in validation files simply remove mempool expiry references."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
